notes: Nigeria uses a 6-digit NIPOST postal code system (first digit = postal region 1–9, first three digits = dispatch district, last three = delivery post office; 001 = General Post Office / head office). On 1 October 2026 NIPOST also introduced the 11-character alphanumeric National Digital Addressing and Postcode System (NDAPS), while 6-digit postal codes remain standard across international forms, KYC, banks, customs, and couriers. Honest coverage note: this directory curates verified state GPOs, major urban districts, LGA seats, and commercial centres — not every street or village in Nigeria. Where public NIPOST compilations disagree on a code, we record the conflict in notes rather than guessing.
